title: Review round 3: Implement jmap-client crate
description: Third review pass after round 2 fix wave. P0 and P1 fixed: timeout, UTF-8 SSE, ClientConfig, StateChange, build().
notes:
Maintainer risk round 3: MEDIUM — raw_buf OOM (P0) is new code from this round; SseEvent/push::StateChange split (P1) is a half-completed consolidation that will cause duplicate handling code in extension crates; Duration::ZERO ambiguity (P1) is a latent dependency-upgrade footgun.
Confidence: 10% chance of missed bug. The raw_buf OOM is the only P0 found and it is clear-cut. The codebase is small (9 files, ~500 lines of logic), I read every line, and the round-2 fixes for timeout, size caps, UTF-8 buffering, and type duplication all landed correctly. The remaining risk is in the reqwest timeout behavior for Duration::ZERO which is operationally observable but not a data-loss bug.
